description: What tpu-llmd hands llmd-planner: the study's inputs plus where the search stands, so the planner can propose arms as deltas against the current incumbent and never re-propose a decided one.

prompt.description: What the orchestrator wants planned this round, in a sentence.

incumbent_config_path.description: The current best llmd-config.json. Every proposed arm is a delta against it.

capabilities_path.description: engine-capabilities.json from llmd-platform, when it exists. Arms needing a connector the image lacks are proposed `blocked_on_engine_capability`, never dropped.

baseline_profile_path.description: The baseline arm's fleet metrics.json (from `deploy collect`), when it exists. The planner reads prefix hit rate, KV occupancy and queue depth from it to rank KV-reuse and capacity arms on evidence rather than catalog hints.

decided_arms.description: Arms already decided or blocked, so the planner dedups and learns from them (a decided `load-only` win says prefix reuse is not the lever).

open_arms.description: Arm ids still open; the planner does not duplicate them.

fleet_mode.description: Adopted fleets cannot take engine-mutating arms; the planner still proposes them, `blocked_on_adopted_fleet`, so the finding is visible.

examples.prompt: Propose the next arms for round 2 of acme-chat-tpu7x.
